content: 'Itsakaxi nuiwarimama
'Itsakaxi niwemama meyunaukatɨ mepakɨ: Tura, Puwa, Yatsuwi meta Tsimiruni.

Tura niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Utsihi, Xepahiyaxi, Keriheri, Yamahi, 'Iwitsani meta Tsamuheri, mɨkɨ meyunaitɨ kwinimieme mekateneuyutakwiwawekaitɨni, meta yu'iwama Tura nuiwarimama mewanɨ'atɨ mekanakɨne. Kemaine wanuiwari xapayari, Rawiri 'amuyeikakaitsie xeitewiyari heimana huta miriyari heimana 'ataxewime tsienituyari (22.600) mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni.
'Itsirahiyaxi 'Utsihi kaninu'ayatɨkaitɨni, 'Itsirahiyaxi niwemama mekanakɨne: Mikaheri, 'Awiriyaxi, Kuheri meta 'Itsiyaxi, meyunaitɨ mɨkɨ meyu'auxɨwitɨ memɨwanɨ'a mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai.
Mepɨyumɨirekai wa'ɨitama meta waniwema, kemaine wanuiwari xapayari, mepɨwarexeiyakai xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'ataxewime miriyari (36.000) teɨteri kuyaxa miemete.
Yunaitɨ 'iwamarixi mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai 'Itsakaxi niwemama nauka tewiyari heimana 'atahuta miriyari (87.000) mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai kuyaxi memeuyutakwiwawe.
Wenikamini nuiwarimama
Wenikamini niwemama mekanakɨne: Wera, Wekexi meta Keriyaheri, mekaniyuhaikani yunaitɨ.

Wera niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Etsiwuni, 'Utsihi, 'Utsiheri, Kerimuti meta 'Iri, meyu'auxɨwitɨ mepakɨ. Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ memanuyetei memɨwanɨ'a mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai meta memeuyutakwiwawe, xeitewiyari heimana huta miriyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana nauka (22.034) mepɨyupaɨmekai kuyakɨ meuyutakwiwawe.
Wekexi niwemama mekanakɨne Tsemira, Kuhatsi, 'Eriyetsexi, 'Erihuhenahi, 'Umiri, Kerimuti, 'Awiyaxi, 'Anatuti meta 'Arameti. Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ Wekexi mepɨniwemamatɨkai,
memanuyetei memɨwanɨ'a mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai yu'iwama wahetsie meta kuyaxi memeuyutakwiwawe mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai. Kemaine wanuiwari xapayari, xeitewiyari heimana huta tsienituyari (20.200) mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni.
Wirihani Keriyaheri punu'ayatɨkai. Wirahani niwemama mekanakɨne: Kehutsi, Wenikamini, 'Ahuri, Kenana, Tsetani, Taritsi meta 'Akitsakaxi.

Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ Keriyaheri mepunuiwarimama, meta memanuyetei memɨwanɨ'a mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai meta memeuyutakwiwawe. Mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni yunaitɨ, tamamata heimana 'atahuta miriyari heimana huta tsienituyari (17.200) teɨteri kuyaxa miemete.
'Ixi niwemama mekanihɨkɨtɨni: Tsupini meta Kupini. Kutsini 'Akexi nu'aya patɨa.
Nepɨtahari nuiwarimama
Nepɨtahari niwemama mekanakɨne: Yatseri, Kuni, Ketsexi meta Tsaruni. Mɨkɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni Wiriha nuiwarimama.
Manatsexi nuiwarimama
Manatsexi niwemama yuparewiwame 'ɨyayatɨtɨ mɨhɨkɨtɨkai Tsiriya kiekame hetsie muwarayexei mekanakɨne: 'Atsirieri meta Makixi, 'ikɨ 'imatɨrieka mieme Karaha paapaya patɨa.
Makixi Mahaka kaniutiwitɨni, Kupini meta Tsupini wa'iwa. Hutarieka mieme waniwe katinitewakaitɨni Tserupekari, mɨkɨ 'ukarawetsixi xeikɨa kaniwarutinuarieni.
Makixi 'ɨyaya Mahaka xeime nunutsi kanayexeiya, mɨkɨ Peretsi katiniterɨwa. Mɨkɨ Tseretsi 'iwaya kanayani 'Urani meta Xekeni wapaapa.
Werahani 'Urani nu'aya kanayani. Mɨkɨ mekanakɨne Karaha niwemama, Makixi nu'aya, mɨkɨta Manatsexi nu'aya.
'Iwaya 'uka Hamureketi 'Itsuri mamaaya kanayani, meta 'Awihetsexi Makira matɨa.
Tsemira niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Ahiyani, Tsikeni, Rikeki meta 'Anihani.
'Epɨrahini nuiwarimama
'Epɨrahini nuiwarimama: Tsutera, Wereri, Takati, 'Erara, Takati,
Tsawari, Tsutera, 'Etsexi meta 'Erari. Kahati kiekatari 'ikɨ yuhutame mekaniwarukwini watewama mewarunawatsirieku.
Mɨixa tukari 'Epɨrahini yuniwema wahetsiemieme kaniyuhiweriekaitɨni, hikɨ 'iwamama mekaniu'axɨani me'inɨtɨanike.
Hikɨ tawari yu'ɨya matɨa xeime mekanayexeiya nunutsi, mɨkɨ Weriya katiniterɨwa hiwerika muxuawekaikɨ wakie.
Weriha nu'aya 'uka Tsera kiekari Weti-Kuruni meutitewatsie mukuma kaniutawewieni meta Weti-Kuruni mukuweritsie mukuma, metatsiere 'Utseni-Tsera.
Weriha nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: Xepa, Xetsepi, Teraha, Takani,
Rarani, 'Amihuri, 'Eritsama,
Nuni meta Kutsuhexi.

Hakewa mɨwarekwietɨkai hakewa memetitekai kanayani Weteri meta kiekari 'etsimɨyeyeu 'auriena mamanetɨka, Narani tau manatineika hepatsie, Ketsehexi meta kiekari 'etsimɨyeyeu 'auriena mamanetɨka tau makayuyuipike hepatsie, meta Tsikeni kiekari 'etsimɨyeyeu 'auriena mamanetɨka naime, metatsiere 'Ayaha kiekariyari 'etsimɨyeyeu 'auriena mamanetɨka naime.

Manatsexi nuiwarimama Wetsehani katiniwapinitɨkaitɨni meta Tanaki, Mekiru metatsiere Ruxi, yu'aurie kiekari 'etsimɨmɨyeyeu mexeiyatɨka naime. Mɨkɨ kiekariyaritetsie mekanikuyaxe Kutse 'Ixaheri nu'aya nuiwarimama.
'Atsexi nuiwarimama
'Atsexi niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Imɨna, 'Itsiwa, 'Itsiwi, Weriya meta wa'iwa 'uka Tsera.
Weriya niwemama mekanakɨne: Hewexi meta Marikiheri, mɨkɨ Wiritsawiti paapaya matɨa.
Hewexi niwemama mekanakɨne: Kapireti, Tsemexi, Kutani meta wa'iwa 'uka Tsuha.
Kapireti niwemama mekanakɨne: Patsaki, Wimari meta 'Atsiwati.
'Iwaya Tsemexi niwemama mekanakɨne: Xuheka, Kehuwa meta 'Arami.
'Iwaya Heremi niwemama mekanakɨne: Tsupaha, 'Imɨna, Tseretsi meta 'Amari.
Tsupaha niwemama mekanakɨne: Tsuhaki, Haxinepexi, Tsuhari, Werihi, 'Imɨra,
Wetsexi, Huri, Tsama, Tsiritsa, 'Itɨrani meta Wehera.
Ketexi niwemama mekanakɨne: Kepune, Pitsipa meta 'Araha.
'Ura niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Araki, Kaniheri meta Xitsiya.

'Ikɨ meyunaitɨ 'Atsexi nuiwarimama mepɨkɨkɨ, memanuyetekai memɨwanɨ'akai yu'iwama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, teɨteri 'aixɨa memɨteheuyutakwiwawe, memɨtɨrɨkawi meta memɨmamariwawe. Kemaine wanuiwari xapayaritsie memaka'uxatsie mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni xeitewiyari heimana 'ataxewi miriyari (26.000) teɨteri kuyaxa miemete.
